annotations.title: Verify Corporate KYA Liability Mandate & Caps

description: Verify an autonomous agent's Know Your Agent (KYA) EIP-712 corporate liability mandate, jurisdiction, expiration status, and whether a proposed USD transaction amount complies with corporate per-transaction caps. Returns approved boolean, corporateEntity, liabilityCoverageUsd, maxTxLimitUsd, and expiration/limit flags. Use this specifically for corporate authorization checks — not for on-chain Sybil scoring (use nullclear_check_reputation).

agentId.description: Registered numeric ERC-8004 agent token ID bound to a KYA mandate

chainId.description: EVM chain ID (default 8453 for Base Mainnet)

transactionAmountUsd.description: Proposed transaction size in USD to validate against the mandate limit

name: nullclear_verify_mandate
